text.arabic_uthmani: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَنُطْعِمُ مَن لَّوْ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ أَطْعَمَهُۥٓ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

words.gloss_range: connector opening a resumed scene without fixing one causal relation
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) resumes the argument by opening another refusal-scene after the prior turning away from signs (36:46). Its visible prefixing to the following scenario marker makes the connector a bound launch, so the social command in this ayah becomes a fresh exhibit inside the same rejection pattern without forcing one narrow causal relation.

topics.headline: resumptive scene hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah adds a new social-refusal exhibit to the prior sign-refusal pattern rather than starting a detached topic.
topics.reason: Rows converge on a connective opening before the scenario frame and a boundary link from 36:46 into 36:47.

words.gloss_range: temporal-conditional frame that makes the summons a repeatable diagnostic scenario
words.prose: {{ar:إِذَا}} ({{tr:idhā}}) frames the summons as a repeatable when-condition. The reply is not treated as one accidental bad answer; each arrival of the command exposes a settled posture.

topics.headline: when-condition makes refusal diagnostic
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reply is treated as a recurring posture triggered by the command, not as a single isolated answer.
topics.reason: Rows identify a temporal-conditional frame governing the passive saying clause and preparing the response.

words.gloss_range: passive perfect speech verb that foregrounds the command content while suppressing the exhorter
words.root_gloss_range: speech, saying, articulated position, and report; the local passive perfect selects an utterance received without naming the speaker

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the later active speech verb that assigns ownership to the rejecting speakers

words.prose: {{ar:قِيلَ}} ({{tr:qīla}}) presents the command as received speech while withholding the exhorter. The passive perfect makes the command complete before the answer, and its contrast with the later active {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}) makes the rejecters own the response. The reported rounded recitation colors the sound but leaves the passive command-frame intact, while the speech-root reprise ties command and refusal into one audible conflict.

topics.headline: passive saying foregrounds command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command content is foregrounded while the exhorter is withheld, so attention falls on the response.
topics.reason: Passive perfect grammar under the scenario frame suppresses speaker identity and foregrounds the uttered command.

topics.headline: variant colors sound, not parse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that reported vocalic coloring can affect recitational texture while leaving the passive command-frame stable.
topics.reason: Variant rows preserve passive morphology and syntactic role; they do not replace the local parse.

topics.headline: command and reply share speech root
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an audible contrast between anonymous summons and accountable reply, staged through the same speech root.
topics.reason: Echo and boundary rows link this passive speech verb with the later active reply and the shift from sign-aversion to dialogue.

words.gloss_range: dative preposition marking the recipients of the passive summons
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) routes the passive utterance directly to its recipients. Before the command is heard, grammar has already fixed who is being addressed, so the later objection cannot pretend the summons missed them.

topics.headline: dative preposition fixes recipients
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command is grammatically routed to them before the imperative arrives.
topics.reason: Rows identify the preposition as the complement of the passive speech verb and as direct address marking.

words.gloss_range: attached third-person plural pronoun for the summoned group before its moral label arrives
words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) keeps the summoned group definite before the ayah names them. The attached pronoun compresses them into the recipient phrase, delaying the moral label until their answer reveals it and carrying the prior sign-refusal into this social scene.

topics.headline: pronoun delays moral label
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the group is addressed before being named, letting identity emerge through response.
topics.reason: Rows link the attached pronoun to the later named rejecters and to continuity from the prior ayah.

words.gloss_range: second-person plural Form IV imperative to let resources go out from the provided source
words.root_gloss_range: outlet, expenditure, maintenance, and support-cost; the local command selects outward spending or support from received provision
words.prose: {{ar:أَنفِقُوا۟}} ({{tr:anfiqū}}) assigns a direct plural obligation before any appeal to providence appears. The Form IV and outlet-support field make resources move outward toward need, while the following source phrase limits the burden to what has been provided. The command also inverts the believer profile of spending from provision (2:3), turning a known guidance-mark into the act the rejecters resist.

topics.headline: imperative assigns collective duty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that human obligation is onstage before the speakers invoke divine will.
topics.reason: Grammar and form rows identify a second-person plural imperative whose source is supplied afterward.

topics.headline: root field makes provision pass outward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that spending is pictured as opening a channel of support, while local grammar selects the commanded expenditure sense.
topics.reason: Root rows support outlet, expenditure, and maintenance pressure, narrowed by the imperative command frame.

topics.headline: known guidance formula is resisted
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that spending from provision, associated with guidance at 2:3, is precisely what the rejecters resist here.
topics.reason: Intertext and boundary rows connect the command to spending-from-provision formulae and to the ayah’s materialization of recognition.

words.gloss_range: fused source and relative phrase meaning from what, with partitive force
words.prose: {{ar:مِمَّا}} ({{tr:mimmā}}) fuses source, breadth, and partiality. It says the spending comes from what was provided, not from an undefined stockpile and not as a demand for everything; the later objection exaggerates a duty already bounded by grammar.

topics.headline: from-what limits and grounds duty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command asks from provided resources, making divine giving the ground of duty rather than an excuse against it.
topics.reason: Rows identify a fused source-relative form with partitive force immediately after the command.

words.gloss_range: perfect provision verb with second-person plural object suffix, marking refusers as recipients first
words.root_gloss_range: sustenance, allotted support, livelihood, and provision; the local verb selects granted provision already received by the addressees
words.prose: {{ar:رَزَقَكُمُ}} ({{tr:razaqakumu}}) marks the refusers as recipients before they are asked to give. The perfect verb presents provision as already received, and the delayed divine subject lets their beneficiary status land first. The provision field includes allotted support, so the word undermines autonomous ownership and prepares the contrast between provision given to you and feeding withheld from him.

topics.headline: suffix marks refusers as recipients first
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the people asked to give are grammatically shown as beneficiaries before they become refusing speakers.
topics.reason: Grammar and form rows center the second-person object suffix and completed provision before the explicit subject.

topics.headline: provision is received support
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the provision is sustaining allotment, not autonomous property, while the local verb selects a completed grant.
topics.reason: Root rows support livelihood and allotted support pressure, narrowed by the local perfect provision verb.

topics.headline: you received, he remains hungry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the pronoun contrast between provision given to you and feeding withheld from him.
topics.reason: Echo rows link the provision verb, spending field, and later feeding object to expose selective use of divine agency.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name as nominative subject of the provision verb
words.root_gloss_range: divine name with worship, devotion, and disputed derivational pressures; locally it names the provider subject
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:Allāhu}}) closes the provision clause by naming the provider as explicit subject. The proper name makes the resource relation personal and accountable, not merely economic. Its later repetition inside the refusal will expose how the same divine name is used first to ground obligation and then to evade it.

topics.headline: divine subject fixes provision agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that provision is grammatically assigned to the named provider, not left as vague possession.
topics.reason: Rows identify the proper name as nominative post-verbal subject of the provision verb.

topics.headline: proper name personalizes the provision relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the resource relation is accountable before the divine name, while derivational disputes remain background pressure.
topics.reason: Semantic rows make the proper name personally and devotionally charged, but local syntax selects subjecthood in the provision clause.

topics.headline: first divine name anticipates later misuse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the name first grounds obligation before it is reused in the excuse.
topics.reason: Intertext and echo rows contrast the first divine name as provider with the later invocation in the feeding objection.

words.gloss_range: active perfect speech verb introducing the owned reply of the rejecters
words.root_gloss_range: speech, saying, and articulated stance; local active perfect selects accountable counter-speech
words.prose: {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}) turns the scene from received command into owned counter-speech. The singular verb before the plural relative subject is normal VSO grammar, but it lets the speech act begin before the speaker group fully lands. The result is a long quotation in which narrated evaluation becomes direct speech and the rejecters articulate their own stance from question to verdict.

topics.headline: active saying assigns reply
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the refusal is owned by named speakers, unlike the anonymous summons.
topics.reason: Grammar rows contrast active perfect reply with earlier passive command speech and identify the quote span.

topics.headline: speech becomes a formulated position
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the answer is an adopted argument, not a stray sound, while local form remains plain saying.
topics.reason: Root rows support statement and position pressure, narrowed by the local Form I perfect speech verb.

topics.headline: quotation exposes their logic
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from narrated evaluation into self-exposing direct quotation.
topics.reason: Discourse and echo rows link the word to the qīla-qāla sequence and boundary movement from description to dialogue.

words.gloss_range: masculine plural relative head that waits for the rejection verb to define the speakers
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) does not identify the speakers by status first. It waits for the following rejection verb, so the group is grammatically defined by the act that the quoted speech will then display.

topics.headline: relative head waits for rejection verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the speakers are identified by the following act of rejection rather than by social status.
topics.reason: Rows identify a plural relative head whose content is completed by the following finite verb.

words.gloss_range: Form I perfect plural verb defining the speakers by completed rejection without an explicit object
words.root_gloss_range: covering, denial, rejection, and ingratitude; locally it names the group whose refusal covers over received provision
words.prose: {{ar:كَفَرُوا۟}} ({{tr:kafarū}}) completes the speaker label before the objection is quoted. With no explicit object, the verb names rejection as a settled stance; after provision has been named, the covering and ingratitude field makes their refusal look like covering over a received favor. The direct pairing with the believers makes the feeding dispute a confrontation between rejection and faith.

topics.headline: objectless perfect names stance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that rejection is made identity-level before the argument is quoted.
topics.reason: Grammar and form rows identify a completed plural verb without an explicit object, completing the relative speaker label.

topics.headline: root field makes refusal ingratitude
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that refusing to spend after provision is a covering-over of received favor, while local grammar selects the rejection label.
topics.reason: Root rows support covering, denial, and ingratitude pressure, narrowed by the local perfect verb.

topics.headline: speaker label frames community contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the feeding dispute is staged as rejection confronting faith, not as neutral economic reasoning.
topics.reason: Intertext and discourse rows pair rejecters with believers and connect this scene to the surah’s rejection thread.

words.gloss_range: prefixed preposition directing the retort toward the believer group
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) marks the believers as the addressed target of the retort. The refusal is not private reasoning; it is polemical speech aimed at the group identified by faith before the feeding question begins.

topics.headline: preposition targets the retort
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the objection is aimed at believers as polemical speech, not kept as private reasoning.
topics.reason: Rows identify the preposition as governing the believer relative phrase after the speech verb.

words.gloss_range: assimilated plural relative head inside the addressee phrase
words.prose: {{ar:لَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:lladhīna}}) keeps the addressee phrase in relative form after the prefixed preposition. It packages the believers as a defined audience whose identity will be supplied by the faith verb, paralleling the earlier relative label for the rejecters.

topics.headline: assimilated relative preserves identity frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the addressees are grammatically defined by faith before the accusation lands.
topics.reason: Rows identify the assimilated segment as a relative pronoun inside the prepositional object.

words.gloss_range: Form IV perfect plural verb defining the addressed group by faith
words.root_gloss_range: faith, trust, safety, and entrusted reliability; locally it names the believers targeted by the accusation
words.prose: {{ar:ءَامَنُوٓا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) defines the retort audience by completed faith before they are accused of error. The trust and safety field makes faith socially concrete in a scene about hunger, and its pairing with spending from provision recalls the believer profile (2:3) now being contested by the rejecters.

topics.headline: faith verb completes the target label
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the people accused of error are first defined by completed faith.
topics.reason: Grammar and form rows identify the Form IV plural perfect as the finite verb completing the relative clause.

topics.headline: faith implies social reliability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that faith carries trust and safety pressure in a hunger scene, while the local verb names belief.
topics.reason: Root rows support trust, safety, and security pressure, narrowed by the local Form IV faith verb.

topics.headline: believers witness contested provision ethics
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the believer profile of faith with spending from provision (2:3) is being challenged by those outside it.
topics.reason: Intertext and echo rows connect faith, spending, provision, and the direct contrast with rejecters.

words.gloss_range: interrogative plus first-person plural imperfect Form IV feeding verb used as a refusal-question
words.root_gloss_range: food, taste, nourishment, and feeding; local Form IV selects causing another person to eat

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the later Form IV feeding result with divine agency and a singular needy object suffix

words.prose: {{ar:أَنُطْعِمُ}} ({{tr:anuṭʿimu}}) turns feeding into a refusal-question. The hamza makes the action itself the challenged point, while Form IV names active nourishment given to another body; even with the food object left implicit, the human recipient remains the grammatical object. The root narrows broad spending to embodied hunger, and the echo with {{ar:أَطْعَمَهُۥٓ}} ({{tr:aṭʿamahū}}) exposes the attempted transfer of responsibility from we feed to He fed.

topics.headline: interrogative performs refusal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the question is not seeking information but challenging the duty to feed.
topics.reason: Grammar, discourse, and synthesis rows identify the hamza question as a rhetorical denial within the quote.

topics.headline: root narrows spending to hunger
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that broad expenditure has become concrete nourishment for a body, while local form selects active feeding.
topics.reason: Root and form rows support food, taste, and causative feeding pressure, narrowed to the local Form IV verb.

topics.headline: we-feed becomes he-fed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the repeated feeding root staging responsibility being pushed from humans onto God.
topics.reason: Echo rows connect the two feeding forms and their agency shift inside the objection.

words.gloss_range: rational relative object of the feeding question and antecedent of the later object pronoun
words.prose: {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}) keeps the needy person syntactically present. The word is the object of the human feeding question and the antecedent of the later object suffix, so the hypothetical clause cannot dissolve the person into an abstraction.

topics.headline: relative keeps needy person present
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same human object links the refused human feeding and the imagined divine feeding.
topics.reason: Rows identify the rational relative as object of the first feeding verb and antecedent of the later suffix.

words.gloss_range: counterfactual condition particle rerouting present obligation into hypothetical divine action
words.prose: {{ar:لَّوْ}} ({{tr:law}}) pivots the objection into counterfactual reasoning. The speakers move from the actual command to an unrealized divine-will condition, defining the needy person by what God did not do rather than by visible need. The missing answer-lam keeps the result compressed into the perfect feeding verb instead of slowing the excuse with a fuller conditional answer.

topics.headline: condition diverts obligation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that present duty is redirected into an unrealized divine-will scenario.
topics.reason: Rows identify the counterfactual particle inside the relative clause and its link to the apodosis.

words.gloss_range: imperfect will verb inside the counterfactual clause, with no explicit object
words.root_gloss_range: willing, determining, and thingness; locally it selects divine willing as quoted by the refusers
words.prose: {{ar:يَشَآءُ}} ({{tr:yashāʾu}}) places divine will inside the rejecters’ quotation, not as narrator doctrine. Its omitted object leaves will rhetorically broad, while the imperfect condition contrasts with the perfect feeding result. The will-and-thingness field shows the hungry person being treated as a case of abstract volition, and the divine-will thread is misused against human action (76:30).

topics.headline: imperfect will remains rhetorically open
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the condition keeps willing open while the imagined feeding result is closed.
topics.reason: Grammar and form rows identify an imperfect verb without explicit object inside the counterfactual clause.

topics.headline: root field abstracts the hungry person
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a human need is recast as a case of divine volition, while local grammar selects willing.
topics.reason: Root rows support will and thingness pressure, narrowed by the local quoted will verb.

topics.headline: divine will is their excuse, not the narrator’s doctrine
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that providence language is reported as the rejecters’ refusal logic, with contrast to human willing under divine will (76:30).
topics.reason: Intertext, discourse, and sound rows place the divine-will term inside the quotation and connect it to a larger will thread.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name as subject of the quoted will verb
words.root_gloss_range: divine name with worship and devotion pressure; locally it names the subject invoked inside their excuse
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:Allāhu}}) names the subject of the quoted will clause. The same proper name that grounded received provision is now centered inside the excuse, between will and feeding result, so the repetition distinguishes divine agency from their use of it.

topics.headline: divine subject centers the condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the divine name resolves whose will they invoke while excluding their own agency.
topics.reason: Grammar rows identify the proper name as nominative subject of the will verb inside the quote.

topics.headline: devotion language is bent into avoidance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that recognition of divine agency can be weaponized against responsibility, while local syntax keeps simple subjecthood.
topics.reason: Semantic rows keep devotion-language pressure but local grammar selects the subject of the quoted condition.

topics.headline: provider becomes cited non-feeder
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same divine name first grounds what they received and then is invoked to explain another person’s hunger.
topics.reason: Echo and intertext rows contrast the first and second divine-name occurrences and their roles in the argument.

words.gloss_range: Form IV perfect feeding verb with singular object suffix, functioning as the counterfactual result
words.root_gloss_range: food, taste, nourishment, and feeding; locally it selects completed feeding imagined as divine action toward the same needy person

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the earlier human feeding question whose root and agency are echoed here

words.prose: {{ar:أَطْعَمَهُۥٓ}} ({{tr:aṭʿamahū}}) completes the counterfactual result while preserving the singular needy person in the suffix. The perfect Form IV imagines feeding as a completed divine act that did not happen, which the speakers use to excuse themselves; the wider food-request field keeps latent need pressure in the background. Its root echo with {{ar:أَنُطْعِمُ}} ({{tr:anuṭʿimu}}) makes the responsibility-shift audible, while other feeding contexts praise the opposite response (76:8).

topics.headline: result keeps the person concrete
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the counterfactual still carries a singular needy object, not a vague policy abstraction.
topics.reason: Grammar and form rows identify the suffix as returning to the relative object and the verb as the result of the counterfactual.

topics.headline: feeding result is bodily nourishment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the argument turns on actual food delivered to one body, while broader food-root derivatives remain background.
topics.reason: Root rows support concrete feeding and latent need pressure, narrowed by the local Form IV perfect.

topics.headline: same feeding root shifts agents
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the exact root echo that transfers duty from humans to God, opposite to praised feeding in 76:8.
topics.reason: Echo and intertext rows connect the two feeding forms, agency shift, and positive feeding contrast.

words.gloss_range: negative particle in an exception-based restriction, not a new conditional

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the earlier counterfactual particle whose conditional reading is not repeated here

words.prose: {{ar:إِنْ}} ({{tr:in}}) begins the closing restriction as negation, not as another condition after {{ar:لَّوْ}} ({{tr:law}}). The following exception particle forces the parse, turning the feeding question into a verdict that confines the believers to one alleged state.

topics.headline: not conditional but restrictive negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the close is an accusation, not a second hypothetical after the divine-will clause.
topics.reason: Rows identify the particle as negation resolved by the exception particle, producing restriction.

words.gloss_range: independent second-person plural pronoun anchoring the closing verbless accusation
words.prose: {{ar:أَنتُمْ}} ({{tr:antum}}) makes the accusation direct. The independent pronoun pivots the quote from we-refusal to you-indictment; within the quote it targets the believers, while the speech boundary also lets the charge rebound onto the speakers’ own logic.

topics.headline: we-refusal pivots to you-accusation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from self-excusing we to targeted you, while the speech-boundary ambiguity lets the accusation rebound.
topics.reason: Rows identify an independent second-person subject in the quoted clause and note the possible rebound at the speech boundary.

words.gloss_range: exception particle completing the restrictive negation and funneling the predicate

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the preceding negation particle completed by this exception marker

words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) completes the restriction begun by {{ar:إِنْ}} ({{tr:in}}). It excludes every predicate except the following prepositional phrase, not a bare noun, so the dispute over feeding becomes a totalizing classification in a location-like state.

topics.headline: exception completes total classification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that all descriptions are excluded except the final state-location phrase.
topics.reason: Rows identify the exception particle as completing negation-plus-exception restriction.

words.gloss_range: preposition making misguidance a locative predicate-state
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) makes the final accusation spatial. The believers are placed inside alleged misguidance rather than merely labeled mistaken, and the prepositional predicate starts the ayah’s closing landing into the two-word seal.

topics.headline: preposition makes error a container
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the accusation pictures believers inside misguidance, not merely mistaken.
topics.reason: Rows identify the preposition as governing the genitive noun and supplying the predicate phrase.

words.gloss_range: indefinite genitive verbal noun governed by the locative predicate and modified by the final adjective
words.root_gloss_range: straying, losing the way, misdirection, and disappearance from the path; locally it names the alleged state of misguidance
words.prose: {{ar:ضَلَٰلٍۢ}} ({{tr:ḍalālin}}) is governed by the locative preposition and modified by the final adjective. Its path-loss field makes the accusation concrete: the rejecters recast a feeding command as misdirection, even as their own reasoning becomes visibly misdirected. The wording also places a Surah 36 warning term in their mouths, with pressure from 36:24, 36:62, and the guidance contrast of 1:7.

topics.headline: case and form build the accusation state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that misguidance is an indefinite verbal-noun state under the locative predicate and locked to its adjective.
topics.reason: Grammar and form rows identify genitive government, indefiniteness, gerund form, and adjectival agreement.

topics.headline: path-loss image rebounds on refusers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that they call the feeding demand misdirection, while the ayah exposes their own route as lost.
topics.reason: Root rows support losing-the-way imagery, narrowed to the local accusation noun.

topics.headline: final verdict displaces the hungry person
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the quote ends with verdict-language rather than the needy person, inserting a Surah 36 warning term into the rejecters’ mouth (36:24; 36:62).
topics.reason: Intertext and discourse rows link the final accusation with same-surah warnings and the structural displacement of the hungry person.

words.gloss_range: Form IV active participle, indefinite genitive adjective agreeing with the misguidance noun
words.root_gloss_range: separation, distinction, manifestation, clarity, and making clear; locally it adjectives the alleged misguidance as manifest
words.prose: {{ar:مُّبِينٍۢ}} ({{tr:mubīnin}}) seals the quote by attaching claimed clarity to misguidance. Agreement makes it an adjective of the accusation, while Form IV participle force can mean clear or making clear; the irony is that their speech makes their own evasion clear. The word draws on the surah’s clarity thread (36:12; 36:17; 36:24; 36:60; 36:69; 36:77) while closing with a nasalized final seal.

topics.headline: final adjective attaches to accusation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that claimed clarity is grammatically locked to misguidance, not offered as a separate judgment.
topics.reason: Grammar and form rows identify agreement, genitive indefiniteness, and Form IV participle shape.

topics.headline: manifest clarity exposes evasion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word can claim obvious error while also making the speakers’ refusal obvious.
topics.reason: Semantic rows support clear and clarifying senses plus separation pressure, narrowed by adjective attachment to the accusation.

topics.headline: clarity thread closes in false accusation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a surah-wide clarity marker is placed in the rejecters’ final word (36:12; 36:17; 36:24; 36:60; 36:69; 36:77).
topics.reason: Intertext, closure, and sound rows connect the final word to same-surah recurrence and the nasalized ending.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction anfiqū mimmā razaqakumu llāhu ... anuṭʿimu.
baseline_models.mechanism: An allotted gift becomes an entrusted flow: provision reaches holders, expenditure carries a share outward, and feeding realizes it at another body.

activation_trace.role: Expenditure sends wealth out and supplies the transfer step.
An apportioned gift marks what is held as received rather than self-originated.
Feeding another names the recipient-side realization of the outgoing share.

changed_reading.before: Give some food to a needy person.
changed_reading.after: Pass onward as feeding part of the allotment God has already routed through you.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The objection man law yashāʾu llāhu aṭʿamahu.
baseline_models.mechanism: The interrogative substitutes divine capacity for commanded human action: because God can directly cause feeding, the speakers deny being intermediate agents.

activation_trace.role: Divine willing supplies the counterfactual capacity on which the refusal turns.
The paired sayings form a negotiation in which a command is answered by a rival account of agency.
The same other-directed feeding is assigned either to the addressees or exclusively to God.

changed_reading.after: God's ability to feed directly is made into a reason that provision-holders should not serve as feeding agents.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Alladhīna kafarū ... in antum illā fī ḍalālin mubīn.
baseline_models.mechanism: Those characterized by covering the gift publicly redescribe its requested transfer as the believers' exposed misdirection; the countercharge protects withholding.

activation_trace.role: Covering a blessing supplies the economic texture of receiving provision while refusing its acknowledgment.
Deviation from the intended route is the label attached to the believers.
Manifest disclosure makes the countercharge emphatically public and supposedly self-evident.

changed_reading.before: They reject charity and insult the believers.
changed_reading.after: Their refusal covers the received gift by publicly relabeling its onward transfer as manifest deviation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly nests divine production inside human work, possession, use, and gratitude, so human feeding is a mode of providence rather than a competitor to it.

activation_trace.role: The focus command requires a holder to make wealth leave as support.
The transferred material remains framed as God's apportioned gift.
Intentional human work participates in the production of what is eaten.
What hands earn supplies a concrete human link inside divinely generated fruitfulness.
Acknowledging the gift names the demanded response to eating and hand-work.
Divine creation supplies livestock before human possession or use.
Human ownership and disposal coexist with divine origination rather than replacing it.
Divine enabling makes difficult resources usable by human agents.
Actual eating is the bodily endpoint of the created, owned, and enabled resource.

structural_cues: 36:33-35 moves from divine enlivening and bringing-forth to human eating, hand-work, and gratitude.
36:71-73 repeats divine creation, human ownership and use, eating, benefits, and the gratitude question.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nested divine creation, human work, possession, use, and gratitude; I infer that feeding is one intended handoff within that nested agency. A live alternative is that these passages illustrate provision generally without specifying charity.

changed_reading.before: Either God feeds the person or humans do.
changed_reading.after: The command names ordinary providence's next human act: divinely created and enabled goods become owned and worked in human hands, then feed another in grateful acknowledgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated will-conditionals distinguish sovereign capacity from the presently sustained arrangement: God could drown, erase sight, or transform, yet mercy leaves people able to act.

activation_trace.role: The refusers turn divine willing into an exemption from their commanded action.
A parallel conditional presents drowning as something God could will without saying that it is the current arrangement.
Lethal drowning makes the unrealized alternative concrete rather than norm-setting.
Mercy names the actual preservation that follows the drowning counterfactual.
The same will formula introduces another unrealized removal of agency.
Erasure of sight specifies a capacity God has not enacted in their present moral situation.
A third conditional keeps divine capacity distinct from the actual field of action.
Transformation in place would remove mobility, highlighting the mobility and agency presently retained.

structural_cues: 36:43-44 pairs an if-We-will catastrophe with actual mercy and temporary benefit.
36:66-67 repeats if-We-will twice for unrealized losses of sight and movement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies capability conditions contrasted with actual preservation, sight, and mobility; I infer that could-will-X does not itself define the present norm or erase commanded agency. A live alternative treats every human act only as an ultimate divine act and rejects this modal distinction.

changed_reading.before: If God has the power to feed directly, humans bear no feeding responsibility.
changed_reading.after: The objection confuses counterfactual sovereign capacity with the actual merciful arrangement in which provision-holders remain able and commanded to act.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact error formula already belongs to the believer's rejection of false worship, then a straight path is contrasted with Satan's mass misleading; the focus accusation is therefore a contested seizure of the surah's route-language.

activation_trace.role: The refusers assign deviation from the right route to the believers.
They claim that the alleged deviation is manifest.
The earlier believer uses the same deviation term for the route of taking other gods.
The exact manifest-error pairing establishes a deliberate verbal echo.
The straight road supplies the positive route against which error is measured.
Uprightness and balance sharpen the contrast with straying.
Later misleading is assigned to the hostile route, reversing the focus speakers' placement of error.
Reason that restrains ignorance challenges the rational pose of the focus objection.

structural_cues: 36:24 and 36:47 repeat the exact pair fī ḍalālin mubīn from opposing mouths.
36:60-62 identifies the manifest enemy, the straight path, and the source of widespread misleading.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exact echo and the later route contrast; I infer that the focus charge is deliberately contested and reversed rather than narrator-endorsed. A live alternative is simple reuse of a polemical formula without a designed reversal.

changed_reading.before: The believers are plainly deluded for asking others to feed.
changed_reading.after: The line stages a seized label: refusers call generosity clear error, while the surah's route-map relocates error to the misleading allegiance behind refusal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The public theological reply becomes an accountable economic act: dispute is interrupted, mouths are sealed, hands speak about acquisition, and both concealed and declared content remain known.

activation_trace.role: The focus reply is argumentative negotiation over who must act.
Covering supplies a possible relation between the declared rationale and what it protects.
Disputation continues until the sudden interruption, placing a limit on verbal defense.
The preventing seal removes the mouth's control of the account.
Intelligible speech transfers from the disputing mouth to the acting hand.
The hand as bodily agent becomes the witness against a merely verbal account.
Testimony discloses action by knowledge rather than assertion.
Acquiring livelihood and benefit reconnects judgment to the economics of retained provision.
Hidden inward content keeps the stated objection from exhausting the act's meaning.
Public disclosure names the outward side represented by their spoken rationale.

structural_cues: 36:49 catches them in dispute, while 36:65 transfers speech from sealed mouths to hands concerning what was earned.
36:76 places their speech beside what they conceal and what they disclose.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a speech-action audit and a hidden-versus-public contrast; I infer that the focus rationale may cover retention of acquired provision. A live alternative is a sincere deterministic argument that is still judged through its economic action.

changed_reading.before: The speakers advance a detached theological proposition.
changed_reading.after: Their proposition is also an accountable act of retention: the mouth's rationale can be displaced by what the provision-acquiring and provision-withholding hand has done.

context_deltas.mechanism: Present benefit lasts only to a term, and the sudden blast closes even the ability to transmit a testament to one's family; expenditure is therefore a voluntary transfer available only while agency remains open.

activation_trace.role: The going and ending of a thing gives expenditure a temporal as well as economic edge.
Voluntary outgoing wealth is the action available in the focus present.
Useful provision for needs is explicitly framed as temporary equipment.
A bounded time gives the useful provision an endpoint.
Loss of ability closes the former field of voluntary action.
An intended transfer of obligation or property can no longer be carried onward.
The family destination makes the failed post-interruption transfer socially concrete.

structural_cues: Immediately after 36:47, 36:49-50 interrupts dispute and removes the ability to make a bequest or return to family.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies temporary benefit, sudden interruption, and inability to bequeath; I infer that the expenditure command is a now-open disposition window. A live alternative takes the sequence only as eschatological warning, without a specific wealth-timing implication.

changed_reading.before: Spend because another person presently needs food.
changed_reading.after: Spend while transfer is still possible; delayed stewardship can become an unmade bequest when the holder's agency closes.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it extends the tunnel-or-outlet image of n-f-q into the surah's ecology. It remains anchored in anfiq, provision, and feeding, and is triggered by grain brought out of earth and springs split open. Render it only as a material analogy, not as a replacement etymology for expenditure.

activation_trace.role: A penetrating passage with an outlet turns spending into an image of opening a route through held resources.
Life-giving descent widens provision from private stock to an ecological supply.
Grain exits dead earth as the first visible release in the nourishment chain.
Springs split open and issue outward, adding a second material outlet.
Eating supplies the bodily endpoint toward which the successive releases move.

changed_reading.before: A holder gives from a static stock.
changed_reading.after: Provision is a linked outlet system: earth releases grain, springs release water, and the holder is asked to become the next opening through which nourishment reaches a body.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins the final creator formula to a social imperative. It remains anchored in qīla, anfiqū, divine willing, and feeding. Render it as a reader-supplied agency analogy only: it neither identifies the unspecified focus speaker with God nor claims that command guarantees human obedience.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Wa-idhā qīla lahum anfiqū ... law yashāʾu llāhu aṭʿamahu.

activation_trace.role: The focus opens with an uttered command and then records the uttered refusal.
The commanded effect requires human expenditure as its responsive means.
Command as demand or obligation supplies an enacted form of authority.
Divine intention supplies the willing side of the final formula.
Will reaches toward an effect through saying, making command a possible mode of mediation.
Coming into occurrence supplies the effect-side of willing speech.

changed_reading.before: If God willed, He would feed without involving us.
changed_reading.after: The command spend may itself be one means by which divine willing addresses human agents and brings feeding into occurrence.

strongest_changes: Provision shifts from zero-sum divine-versus-human agency to mediation through created goods, ownership, work, and gratitude.
Repeated divine-will counterfactuals distinguish sovereign capacity from the actual moral arrangement and undercut the excuse.
The clear-error charge reverses under the surah's earlier and later route language.
Immediate interruption turns expenditure into a time-bounded chance to transfer.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah repetition linked provision, hands, will-conditionals, accusation labels, and final creative speech without collapsing them into one reading; the outlet-chain and command-as-means readings remain deliberately exploratory.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the refusal's theology is sincere or functions chiefly as a cover for retaining goods.
How far the hand and ownership cluster licenses stewardship rather than only a general illustration of provision.
Whether the outlet and final-command analogies should surface in prose or remain diagnostic.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Provision is blocked from becoming circulation.** `ن ف ق` B002 is wealth going out as expenditure; `ر ز ق` B001 is allotted gift; `ط ع م` B002 feeding; `ك ف ر` B004 covers over a favor. The command asks received allotment to move onward, while the objection uses divine will to stop that transfer. I infer that covering the gift's source also covers its intended circulation. The ayah reads as a failed provision network, not only stinginess.
2. **Theological speech becomes an exit tunnel.** `ن ف ق` B003 is a tunnel with an exit and B004 showing one face while concealing another exit. Exploratorily, the command's root is activated by the rejecters' pious-sounding appeal to God's will. I infer that the argument creates a verbal exit from material obligation. The reading remains anchored in *anfiqū*: true outflow is replaced by rhetorical escape.
3. **The earlier diagnosis is polemically inverted.** `ض ل ل` B001 and `ب ي ن` B004 repeat 36:24. The believers are called clearly astray for demanding circulation. I infer that the echo contests whether divine agency cancels or grounds human responsibility. The ayah preserves two incompatible causal models rather than merging them.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 36:71-73's delegated ownership and benefits made the blocked circulation more concrete: provision entrusted for use can be acknowledged through transfer or covered through possessive reasoning.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Provision is designed to pass through, but denial closes the outlet.** **ن ف ق B002** anchors wealth going out as expenditure; **ر ز ق B001** supplies allotted gift; **ك ف ر B004** supplies covering over a favor; and **ط ع م B002** anchors feeding another. The command's **مِمَّا** makes the possessed share derive from prior provision; the objectors invoke divine willing to stop its onward movement. Those relations are supplied; the inferred arrow is *allotment makes the recipient a conduit, while ingratitude recasts the conduit as terminal owner*. Their theology functions as a plug in a distribution channel.
2. **The claim about divine capacity masks human nonresponse.** **ش ي ء B001** supplies willing in **يَشَآءُ**, while **ط ع م B011** supplies ability beneath the feeding root. The speakers posit God's ability as grounds for withholding their own, even though the imperative addresses their available share. The packet supplies both capacities; the abductive diagnosis is *appeal to unlimited agency is used to erase delegated practical agency*. “Manifest error” reads as a visible mismatch between argument and possession.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: **Later surprise.** 36:50 removes their capacity to transmit even a final charge, exposing the cost of treating held provision as terminal ownership; 36:52 then recognizes the promise they had deferred. Withheld flow ends in an inability to pass anything onward.

baseline.text: Onlara, 'Allah'ın size verdiği rızıktan harcayın' denildiğinde inkâr edenler inananlara, 'Allah dileseydi doyuracağı kişiyi biz mi doyuralım? Siz açık bir sapkınlık içindesiniz' derler.

findings.text: Rızık, alan kişiyi bir geçiş noktası yaparken inkâr onu akışı durduran son sahip gibi davranmaya iter.
İlahi irade hakkındaki söz, maddi sorumluluktan çıkmak için kullanılan sözel bir kaçış yoluna dönüşür.
Sınırsız ilahi güce başvurmak, insana verilmiş somut doyurma gücünü ve sorumluluğunu silmek için kullanılır.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A received good remains life-giving only when it is admitted, protected, and passed onward rather than turned aside or covered.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Expenditure behaves like an open tunnel, while ingratitude behaves like a cultivator covering seed but refusing the growth that should follow.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Provision that must pass through
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An allotted food-resource enters possession, should exit through expenditure and feeding, but is blocked by denial and loss of direction.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: money flowing outward (quranic:root_001537:B002/m01); tunnel with an outlet (quranic:root_001537:B003/m01); allotted gift (quranic:root_000560:B001/m01); sustaining food (quranic:root_000560:B002/m01); eating and tasting (quranic:root_000934:B001/m01); feeding another (quranic:root_000934:B002/m01); livelihood and hospitality (quranic:root_000934:B004/m01); settled trust (quranic:root_000054:B002/m01); covering a benefit (quranic:root_001307:B004/m01); covering seed with soil (quranic:root_001307:B008/m01); departure from the right route (quranic:root_000913:B001/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Provision is a throughput system. Allocation and food enter; expenditure opens an outlet; feeding carries the resource to another body. Denial covers the received good like seed under soil but suppresses its expected emergence, so the blocked flow becomes ethical misdirection.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı sesle ortaya çıkarılan söz ve harflerden kurulu sözlü ifade olarak verir. Geçici çerçeve aynı çekirdeği taşıyor; dil organı, hükümdar unvanı ve mecazi yan kullanımlar bu dalın dışında kalır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: القل القليل؛ رماه الله بالقل والذل أي بالقلة والذلة (jamhara)؛ شيء قليل وجمعه قلل؛ قل الشيء يقل قلة؛ قلله في عينه؛ أقل افتقر؛ استقله عده قليلا (sihah)؛ قل الشيء يقل قلة فهو قليل وقلال؛ القل من الرجال الخسيس الدنيء؛ قليلة ولا كثيرة؛ قليلا ما يؤمنون؛ قاللت لفلان؛ تقاللت ما أعطاني (tahdhib)؛ القلة والكثرة يستعملان في الأعداد؛ يكنى بالقلة عن الذلة؛ يكنى بها تارة عن العزة؛ قليل يعبر به عن النفي (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyin en üstünü veya başını çekirdek anlam olarak verir; dağın yuvarlak üst bölümü, insan başı ve kılıcın başındaki topuz bu çekirdeğin açık uzmanlaşmalarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol uzamsal başı ve en üst parçayı bildirir; sayısal azlık ya da büyük kap anlamını içermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel baş ve en üst bölüm anlamı ile dağ tepesi, insan başı ve kılıç topuzu gibi yapıya bağlı uzmanlaşmalar ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin başını veya en üst bölümünü bildirir. Dağın üstteki yuvarlak parçası, insan başı ve kılıcın sap ucundaki topuz bu uzamsal çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir nesnenin veya oluşumun başı ya da en üstte bulunan bölümüdür.
Dağın en üstünde yer alan, kimi tanımda yuvarlak biçimli bölümünü adlandırır.
İnsan başı ile kılıcın sap ucundaki başlık veya topuz da aynı üst ve baş kavramıyla adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir şeyin başı ve en üst bölümü üzerinde birleşir; dağ tepesi temel örnektir, insan başı ile kılıç topuzu da aynı biçimsel ve uzamsal çizgide yer alır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir nesnenin ya da doğal oluşumun en üst bölümünü ve başını kapsayan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Baş olma ile uzamsal olarak en üstte bulunma çekirdeğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dağın en üst ve kimi zaman yuvarlak bölümünün adlandırıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dağa özgü en üst bölüm uzmanlaşmasını doğrudan korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsan başının veya başka bir şeyin baş sayılan üst bölümünün kastedildiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Üst bölümün baş olarak kavranmasını kısa ve doğal biçimde verir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kılıcın sap ucunda bulunan başlık ya da topuz parçası anlatılırken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kılıca özgü baş veya üst parça uzmanlaşmasını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Baş ve üst bölüm çekirdekleri yakındır; bu kol tepe ve topuz biçimini öne çıkarırken komşu kol başı daha geniş varlık ve kullanım alanlarında işler.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol somut baş ve üst parça sınırında kalır; komşu kol fiziksel doruktan toplumsal yüceliğe uzanan daha geniş bir yükseklik alanı kurar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol başı, tepeyi ve en üstte bulunan parçayı bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol sayı, miktar veya ölçü bakımından azlığı bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Aynı kökün sesçe yakın iki ayrı anlam kolu olmaları dışında ortak çekirdekleri yoktur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu anlam uzamsal bir üst bölüm adıdır; komşu anlam ise çokluğun karşıtı olan nicelik durumudur.

branches.what_is_ar: قُلَّة الجبل وأعلى كل شيء، ورأس الإنسان، وقبيعة السيف
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس القلة بمعنى الصغر أو العدد القليل، وليس إناء القُلَّة
branches.source_phrase_ar: القلة قلة الجبل وهي القطعة تستدير في أعلاه وهي القنة (jamhara)؛ القلة أعلى الجبل؛ قلة كل شيء أعلاه؛ رأس الإنسان قلة (sihah)؛ قلة كل شيء رأسه؛ قلة الجبل أعلاه؛ قبيعة السيف قلته؛ سيف مقلل (tahdhib)؛ قلة الجبل شعفه (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi büyük bir küp veya iri kap anlamında birleşir; iki kaplık ölçü ve belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler de aynı kap anlamını somutlaştırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol büyük bir kap türünü ve onun ölçü değerini kapsar; nicelik azlığı veya dağ tepesi anlamını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Büyük küp anlamı çekirdektir; belirli bir bölgeye bağlanan kap adı ile iki kaplık ölçü yalnızca kendi yapılardaki uzmanlaşmalardır.

concept_map.definition: Büyük bir küpü veya küpe benzeyen iri kabı bildirir. Belirli bir bölgenin iri küpleri ve iki böyle kabın aldığı miktar bu kap anlamına bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Küpe benzeyen, özellikle sıvı taşımaya veya saklamaya elverişli büyük bir kaptır.
Belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler veya büyük toprak kaplar bu adın tanınmış bir türünü oluşturur.
İki büyük kap, bu iki kabın kendisini veya onların aldığı sıvı miktarını bildiren bir ölçü değeri kazanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar iri bir küp veya büyük kap üzerinde birleşir; tanınmış bölgesel kaplar büyüklüğü örnekler, iki kaplık kullanım ise nesne adını kapasite ölçüsüne taşır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Küpe benzeyen iri kabı adlandıran temel ve en doğal Türkçe karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Kabın küp türünde ve olağandan büyük oluşunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kabın özellikle su alması ve büyük kapasitesi öne çıkarıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Büyük kabı ve kaynakta belirtilen su taşıma kapasitesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İki kabın kendisinden çok onların aldığı sıvı miktarı ölçü olarak kastedildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İki büyük kabın kapasitesine dayanan ölçü kullanımını tam olarak korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: iki büyük küp veya bunların aldığı miktar

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol bir şeyin başını, tepesini veya en üst bölümünü bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Aynı kökün sesçe yakın iki ayrı anlam kolu olmaları dışında ortak çekirdekleri yoktur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Biri hacimli bir kap ve onun ölçüsüdür; diğeri bir varlığın uzamsal olarak en üstteki parçasıdır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: القلة التي جاءت في الحديث مثل قلال هجر هي جرار عظام (jamhara)؛ القلة إناء للعرب كالجرة الكبيرة؛ قلال هجر شبيهة بالحباب (sihah)؛ قلتين يعني هذه الحباب العظام واحدتها قلة؛ قلال هجر؛ القلة منها تأخذ مزادة من الماء (tahdhib)؛ القلة ما أقله الإنسان من جرة وحب (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yükü taşıma veya taşıyabilme ile öznenin yükselip harekete geçmesini aynı kolda açıkça toplar; kuşun uçuşa kalkması, göğün yükselmesi ve yolcuların yüklenip ayrılması ayrı katılımcı gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Taşıma, yükselme ve yüklenerek yola koyulma bu kolun sınırıdır; salt sayısal azlık bu anlamlara katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yük taşıma ile yükselme çekirdek çizgileri ayrılır; ağır bulut taşıma, uçuşa kalkma ve yolcuların ayrılması yalnızca kendi özne ve yapılarında geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir yükü kaldırıp taşıyabilmeyi veya üstlenmeyi ve bir öznenin yükselerek harekete geçmesini bildirir. İkinci çizgi kuşun uçuşa kalkmasını, göğün yükselmesini ve yolcuların yüklenip yola koyulmasını kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi kaldıracak gücü bulmak, onu taşımak veya yük olarak üstlenmektir.
Bir öznenin aşağıdaki konumundan yükselmesi veya kuş gibi harekete ve uçuşa başlamasıdır.
Yolcuların yüklerini alıp bulundukları yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlamasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir yükü kaldırıp taşıma ile yukarı kalkarak harekete geçme çizgilerini bir araya getirir; kuş, gök, bulut ve yolcu örnekleri katılımcıya göre bu iki çizgiyi somutlaştırır.

concept_gloss.text: yük kaldırma, yükselme ve yola koyulma

error_profile.preserves: Yük üstlenme, yükselme ve yolculuk için harekete geçme bileşenlerini birlikte korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişiyi korku veya öfke yüzünden tutan titreme ve silkinişi açıkça tanımlar; genel hareket kararsızlığı değil, duygusal tetikleyicisi bulunan bedensel bir sarsıntı söz konusudur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol insanda korku veya öfkeyle beliren titremeyle sınırlıdır; nesnelerin genel sallanma ve yerinde duramama hali ayrı koldadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Duygudan doğan titreme temel addır; kişiyi titremenin tutması ve öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi yalnızca ilgili yapılara bağlı anlatımlardır.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın korku veya öfke yüzünden titremesi, ürpermesi ya da bedensel olarak silkelenmesidir. Durum, kişiyi bir titreme nöbetinin tutması veya öfkenin titremeyle dışa vurulması biçiminde anlatılabilir.

facets.statement: İnsan bedeninde beliren titreme, ürperti veya istemsiz silkiniş halidir.
Titremenin belirleyici nedeni korku ya da öfkedir.
Belirli yapılarda titremenin kişiyi tutması veya kişinin öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar insandaki titreme ve silkinişte birleşir; korku ile öfke başlıca nedenlerdir ve durum hem kişiyi tutan bir nöbet hem öfkenin bedensel belirtisi olarak anlatılır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Duygusal nedeni ve bedensel titremeyi birlikte taşıyan bütün kol için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Korku veya öfke koşulunu ve bunun doğurduğu bedensel titremeyi birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Korkunun yol açtığı kısa ve istemsiz bedensel titreme bağlamında kullanılır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Öfkenin bedensel titreme halinde dışa vurulduğu kişi bağlamlarına özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Öfke nedenini ve onunla birlikte ortaya çıkan titremeyi korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi hareket ettirip sallandırma, nesnenin bulunduğu yerde kararlı duramaması ve hareketin çıkardığı sesi birlikte verir; bunlar tek bir fiziksel hareket olayının neden, sonuç ve işitsel yönleridir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi hareket ettirerek yerinden oynatmayı ve onun kararsızca sallanıp bulunduğu yerde duramamasını bildirir; bu hareketin çıkardığı ses de aynı olayın işitsel yönüdür.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi hareket ettirip onun yerinden oynamasına ve sarsılmasına neden olmaktır.
Nesnenin bulunduğu yerde sabit kalmayıp sallanması, oynaması veya düzensiz hareket etmesidir.
Sallanma ve yer değiştirme sırasında çıkan ses, hareket olayının işitsel belirtisi olarak adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar dışarıdan hareket ettirme ile nesnenin kararsızca sallanıp yerinde duramaması üzerinde birleşir; hareketin sesi bu fiziksel olayın ayrılmaz işitsel belirtisi olarak eklenir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnızca tükenme ve sona ermeyi değil, hayvanın ölmesini, satışın alıcı bularak elde kalmamasını, koşunun çabuk kesilmesini, yaranın soyulmasını ve semiren develerin tüy dökmesini de kapsar. Bu nedenle dal korunabilir, ancak genel sona erme çekirdeği ile belirli yapılara bağlı uzantılar birbirinden ayrılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, genel tükenme çekirdeğini kapsar; pazarın canlanması, ölüm, çabuk kesilme, soyulma ve tüy dökme yalnızca belirtilen kullanım çevrelerinde geçerlidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal hem yalın tükenme anlamını hem de belirli özne ve söz öbeklerine bağlı özel anlamları içerir; özel kullanımlar yalın çekirdeğe genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin varlığını, miktarını ya da sürekliliğini yitirerek tükenmesi veya sona ermesidir. Belirli kullanımlarda hayvanın ölmesi, satışın elde kalmadan alıcı bulması, hareketin çabuk kesilmesi ya da bir yüzey unsurunun soyulup dökülmesi bu çekirdeğin ayrı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir şey tükenir, geçip gider veya sürekliliğini yitirerek sona erer.
Canlı hayvan bakımından sona erme, hayvanın ölmesi olarak gerçekleşir.
Fiyat, satış veya pazar bakımından malın durgunlaşmadan elden çıkması ve alıcılarının çoğalması anlatılır.
Koşu veya yolculuk bakımından hareketin kısa sürede kesilmesi anlatılır.
Yaranın kabuğunun soyulması veya semiren develerin tüylerinin dökülmesi, yüzeydeki bir unsurun ayrılıp gitmesi olarak anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, tükenip sona erme merkezinden hayvanın ölümüne, malın alıcı bulup elde kalmamasına, koşunun çabuk kesilmesine ve yüzeydeki kabuk ya da tüyün ayrılmasına uzanan kullanımları birlikte verir. Bu özel gerçekleşmeler aynı dalda yer alsa da kendi kullanım koşullarına bağlıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, geçim için çıkan paranın yanı sıra mal dışındaki şeylerin zorunlu veya gönüllü biçimde elden çıkarılmasını ve kişinin elindekini yitirerek yoksullaşmasını da içerir. Bu yüzden dal yalnızca paranın çıkışı olarak tanımlanamaz; eylem, gider ve sonuç ayrı yüzler olarak korunmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Genel çekirdek, bir şeyi gider veya verme amacıyla elden çıkarmaktır; kişinin yoksullaşması yalnızca belirtilen özne yapısında bu eylemin sonucudur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, gider ve harcama bildiren biçimlerle kişinin malını yitirip yoksullaşmasını bildiren özel yapıyı birlikte içerir; sonuç anlamı yalın biçimlere yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Malı veya başka bir şeyi zorunlu ya da gönüllü olarak bir amaç uğruna elden çıkarma ve bunun gider olarak elde kalmamasıdır. Kişi öznesiyle kurulan özel kullanımda elindekinin tükenmesi sonucu yoksullaşma anlatılır.

facets.statement: Mal veya başka bir şey, bir amaç uğruna verilerek ya da kullanılarak elden çıkarılır.
Elden çıkarma, kişinin kendisi ve geçindirmekle yükümlü olduğu kişiler için yapılan gideri kapsar.
Eylemin konusu yalnızca para değildir ve eylem zorunlu veya gönüllü olabilir.
Belirli kişi öznesiyle, elindekinin veya malının gitmesi sonucunda yoksullaşması anlatılır.
Bir kişi, çok gider yapan ve elindekini sıkça harcayan kimse olarak nitelenebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, kişinin kendisi ve geçindirdiği kişiler için yapılan gideri, para veya başka bir şeyin zorunlu ya da gönüllü olarak elden çıkarılmasını ve elindekini yitiren kişinin yoksullaşmasını kapsar. Çok harcayan kişiye verilen niteleme de bu gider alanına bağlıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, toprak altında başka bir yere açılan geçidi ve bir kemirgenin yuvasında incelttiği gizli çıkışı açıkça birlikte verir. Hayvanın bu çıkışa girmesi ve başıyla yarıp dışarı çıkması, geçidin çıkışlı olma özelliğine bağlı eylemlerdir; dalın fiziksel sınırı bu çerçevede tutarlıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın çekirdeği, başka bir yere çıkışı bulunan yer altı geçididir; yuva girişi, gizli çıkış ve hayvanın girip çıkması bu fiziksel yapıya bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, çıkışlı yer altı geçidini adlandıran biçimlerle bir kemirgenin gizli çıkışına girip çıkmasını bildiren özel yapıları birlikte tutar; eylemler yalın geçit adına katılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Toprağın altında uzanıp başka bir yere açılan ve dışarı çıkmaya elveren geçittir. Bir kemirgen yuvasındaki inceltilmiş, gizli çıkış ile hayvanın bu çıkışa girmesi veya onu yarıp dışarı çıkması bu yapının özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Yer altında uzanan geçidin başka bir yere açılan kullanılabilir bir çıkışı vardır.
Bir kemirgen, yuvasının bir bölümünü dışarı açılabilecek kadar inceltir ve bu bölümü gizli çıkış olarak bırakır.
Hayvan, sıkıştırıldığında inceltilmiş bölümü başıyla yararak bu gizli çıkıştan dışarı çıkar.
Hayvanın gizli çıkışına yönelip onun içine girmesi de aynı yuva yapısına bağlı olarak anlatılır.
İnceltilmiş gizli çıkış, bazı kullanımlarda yer altı geçidi adıyla aynı adlandırma alanında yer alır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, başka bir yere çıkışı bulunan yer altı geçidini ve kemirgen yuvasındaki inceltilmiş gizli çıkışı aynı yapısal özellik çevresinde toplar. identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kişinin içinde taşıdığının tersini göstermesini ve özellikle inanç alanında dışarıdan bağlı görünürken gizlice bu bağlılığın dışında kalmasını aynı çekirdekte birleştirir. Yer altı geçidiyle kurulan adlandırma bağlantısı açıklayıcı bir benzetidir; dalın tanımı fiziksel geçit değil, saklanan iç tutum ile gösterilen dış tutum arasındaki karşıtlıktır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, içte saklanan inanç veya tutumun tersini dışarıya gösterme durumudur; genel aldatma, gösteriş ve açıkça inançtan dönme bununla özdeş değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın anlamıyla iç tutumun tersini dışarıya gösterme ve inançta gizli ayrılık çekirdeğinde tanımlanır; başka dallardaki geçit veya harcama anlamları içeri alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin içindeki inanç veya tutumun tersini dışarıya göstermesi, bir bağlılığa girmiş görünürken ondan gizlice ayrı kalmasıdır. Dış görünüş ile saklanan iç durum arasındaki bilinçli karşıtlık dalın kurucu özelliğidir.

facets.statement: Kişi, içinde sakladığı inanç veya tutumun tersini dışarıya gösterir.
İnanç alanında kişi dışarıdan bağlı görünürken içten inanmamayı veya karşıtlığı saklar.
Durum, bir bağlılığa bir kapıdan girip başka bir kapıdan gizlice çıkma görüntüsüyle açıklanır.
Adlandırma, gizli bir çıkışı bulunan yer altı geçidi görüntüsüyle ilişkilendirilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, kişinin içindeki karşıtlığı veya inanmamayı saklayıp dışarıya başka bir bağlılık göstermesini merkez alır. Bir kapıdan girip diğerinden gizlice çıkma ve gizli çıkışlı yer altı geçidi görüntüleri, iç durum ile dış görünüş arasındaki bu ayrılığı açıklar.

Yiyecek, yağmur ve asker ödeneği bu genel çekirdeğin tamamı değil, ayrı dallarda belirginleşen özel gerçekleşmelerdir.

concept_map.definition: Bir alıcıya yararlanması için maddi veya manevi bir payın verilmesi, ayrılması ya da ulaşmasının sağlanmasıdır. Pay belirli bir zamanda verilebildiği gibi süreklilik de gösterebilir.

facets.statement: Alıcıya yararlanacağı bir şey verilir veya onun için bir pay ayrılır.
Belirli zamanda verilen paydan düzenli ya da süren yardıma doğru kapsam genişleyebilir.
Verilen yarar mal, toplumsal konum veya bilgi gibi maddi ve manevi türlerde gerçekleşebilir.
Sağlayan adı, payı yaratanı, vereni veya alıcıya ulaşmasına aracılık edeni belirtebilir.
